key: Through the binoculars, a waterfall can be seen pouring down into the city.
en: Through the binoculars, a waterfall can be seen pouring down into the city.
ja: 双眼鏡越しに、街へと流れ落ちる滝が見える。

key: An elegant cabin rests above it.
en: An elegant cabin rests above it.
ja: その上には、優雅な山小屋がたたずんでいる。

key: Through the binoculars, a small cabin in the woods can be seen.
en: Through the binoculars, a small cabin in the woods can be seen.
ja: 双眼鏡越しに、森の中の小さな小屋が見える。

key: A Pikachu is sitting on top of it.
en: A Pikachu is sitting on top of it.
ja: ピカチュウがその上に座っている。

key: Through the binoculars, a small city can be seen on the cliffs above.
en: Through the binoculars, a small city can be seen on the cliffs above.
ja: 双眼鏡越しに、崖の上の小さな街が見える。

key: There's no activity whatsoever. The streets are entirely empty.
en: There's no activity whatsoever. The streets are entirely empty.
ja: 活動の様子は一切ない。通りは完全に無人だ。

key: It seems to be bustling with people out and about! The streets are livelier than ever.
en: It seems to be bustling with people out and about! The streets are livelier than ever.
ja: 人々でにぎわっているようだ! 通りはかつてないほど活気に満ちている。

key: This center is the local extension of a breeding project.
en: This center is the local extension of a breeding project.
ja: このセンターは、繁殖プロジェクトの地域拠点です。

key: Using samples raised by the Breeding Center on Azurine Island, we work day and night to restore the wild Pokémon to Reborn!
en: Using samples raised by the Breeding Center on Azurine Island, we work day and night to restore the wild Pokémon to Reborn!
ja: アズリン島の繁殖センターで育てられた個体を使い、リボーンに野生ポケモンを取り戻すべく、日夜活動しています!

key: We're happy to be productively communicating with our sister facility again!
en: We're happy to be productively communicating with our sister facility again!
ja: 姉妹施設と、再び有意義なやり取りができるようになって、うれしく思っています!

key: Although we haven't heard from the Azurine Center in quite a while. I do hope nothing's happened.
en: Although we haven't heard from the Azurine Center in quite a while. I do hope nothing's happened.
ja: もっとも、アズリンセンターからは、しばらく連絡がないんですよね。何もなければいいのですが。

key: This center is for wildlife research and the preservation of Pokémon species in nature.
en: This center is for wildlife research and the preservation of Pokémon species in nature.
ja: このセンターは、野生生物の研究と、自然界におけるポケモンの種の保全のためのものです。

key: We keep close watch on the natural activity of all the Pokémon in this area.
en: We keep close watch on the natural activity of all the Pokémon in this area.
ja: この地域のすべてのポケモンの、自然な活動を注意深く観察しています。

key: Many of the Pokémon around here are in constant competition. It's quite interesting!
en: Many of the Pokémon around here are in constant competition. It's quite interesting!
ja: この辺りのポケモンの多くは、常に競い合っています。とても興味深いですよ!

key: Tauros and Bouffalant constantly butt heads- literally- for dominance over the Miltank and land.
en: Tauros and Bouffalant constantly butt heads- literally- for dominance over the Miltank and land.
ja: ケンタロスとバッフロンは、ミルタンクと縄張りをめぐって、文字通り常に角を突き合わせています。

key: Even in the forests, many Bug-types will engage each other for control of resources.
en: Even in the forests, many Bug-types will engage each other for control of resources.
ja: 森の中でも、多くのむしタイプが資源の支配をめぐって争っています。

key: Ultimately, we seek to restore equilibrium to the region...
en: Ultimately, we seek to restore equilibrium to the region...
ja: 最終的には、この地域に均衡を取り戻すことを目指しているのですが……

key: But perhaps we shouldn't have introduced these species to the area together.
en: But perhaps we shouldn't have introduced these species to the area together.
ja: これらの種を一緒にこの地域に導入すべきではなかったのかもしれません。

key: Given the constant conflict among the wild Pokémon, we've observed that the Pokémon tend to be thankful to those who help them overcome their opponent.
en: Given the constant conflict among the wild Pokémon, we've observed that the Pokémon tend to be thankful to those who help them overcome their opponent.
ja: 野生ポケモン同士の絶え間ない争いを見る限り、対戦相手を打ち負かす手助けをしてくれた者に、ポケモンは感謝する傾向があるようです。

key: For instance, the Tauros here will even be so kind as to allow a human who helps them to ride on them!
en: For instance, the Tauros here will even be so kind as to allow a human who helps them to ride on them!
ja: 例えば、ここのケンタロスは、手助けした人間なら親切にも乗せてくれることさえあります!

key: Our studies show that Bouffalant tend to be the most standoffish of the Pokémon around here.
en: Our studies show that Bouffalant tend to be the most standoffish of the Pokémon around here.
ja: 私たちの研究によると、バッフロンはこの辺りのポケモンの中で、最もよそよそしい傾向があります。

key: They have a tendency to charge about uncaringly.
en: They have a tendency to charge about uncaringly.
ja: 見境なく突進する傾向があります。

key: In fact, when they do so, they often neglect to steer and end up crashing into or displacing other objects.
en: In fact, when they do so, they often neglect to steer and end up crashing into or displacing other objects.
ja: 実際、突進する際は方向を操作しないことが多く、他の物にぶつかったり、押しのけたりしてしまいます。

key: Tauros will sometimes let Trainers ride them. It's quite an experience!
en: Tauros will sometimes let Trainers ride them. It's quite an experience!
ja: ケンタロスは、時々トレーナーを乗せてくれます。なかなかの体験ですよ!

key: They move swiftly and will even jump up ledges effortlessly.
en: They move swiftly and will even jump up ledges effortlessly.
ja: 素早く動き、段差も苦もなく飛び越えます。

key: However, they are still finnicky creatures. Tauros greatly dislike going through very tall grass with a human riding them.
en: However, they are still finnicky creatures. Tauros greatly dislike going through very tall grass with a human riding them.
ja: ただ、彼らは気難しい生き物でもあります。ケンタロスは、人を乗せたまま丈の高い草むらを進むのを、ひどく嫌がります。

key: Our current hypothesis is that the grass somehow disrupts their balance, but it could just be sheer stubbornness.
en: Our current hypothesis is that the grass somehow disrupts their balance, but it could just be sheer stubbornness.
ja: 現在の仮説では、草が何らかの形でバランスを乱すのではないかと考えていますが、単なる頑固さかもしれません。

key: Many of the Pokémon in the forests are drawn to the scent of Honey produced by the Combee in the woods.
en: Many of the Pokémon in the forests are drawn to the scent of Honey produced by the Combee in the woods.
ja: 森のポケモンの多くは、森に住むミツハニーが作るあまいミツの香りに引き寄せられます。

key: So popular is this nectar that Pokémon with a particular taste for it-- Heracross and Pinsir-- will often fight each other for it.
en: So popular is this nectar that Pokémon with a particular taste for it-- Heracross and Pinsir-- will often fight each other for it.
ja: この蜜はとても人気があるため、特に好むポケモン――ヘラクロスとカイロス――は、しばしばそれをめぐって争います。

key: We've attempted to capture some of the Bug-types in the forest to study them further...
en: We've attempted to capture some of the Bug-types in the forest to study them further...
ja: さらなる研究のため、森のむしタイプを何匹か捕獲しようと試みたのですが……

key: But when they're engaged in combat with each other, it seems they're impossible to catch.
en: But when they're engaged in combat with each other, it seems they're impossible to catch.
ja: お互いに戦っている最中は、捕獲が不可能なようです。

key: Their focus is honed to the point that they can easily deflect any Ball. Unfortunate...
en: Their focus is honed to the point that they can easily deflect any Ball. Unfortunate...
ja: 集中力が研ぎ澄まされていて、どんなボールも簡単にはじいてしまいます。残念なことです……

key: We keep track of the Miltank here for breeding purposes.
en: We keep track of the Miltank here for breeding purposes.
ja: ここのミルタンクは、繁殖目的で追跡調査しています。

key: After all, we don't want the population to spiral; we're just trying to keep it in balance for now.
en: After all, we don't want the population to spiral; we're just trying to keep it in balance for now.
ja: 個体数が制御不能に増えるのは避けたいので、今のところはバランスを保とうとしているだけです。

key: Miltank produce milk very slowly normally, but given proper diet and conditioning, the process can be sped up exponentially.
en: Miltank produce milk very slowly normally, but given proper diet and conditioning, the process can be sped up exponentially.
ja: ミルタンクは通常、乳を出すのがとても遅いのですが、適切な食事と調整を与えれば、その過程を飛躍的に速めることができます。

key: Our Miltank prefer and are conditioned to an Oran diet- that is, Oran Berries. Consequently, when given one, they produce their milk rapidly.
en: Our Miltank prefer and are conditioned to an Oran diet- that is, Oran Berries. Consequently, when given one, they produce their milk rapidly.
ja: ここのミルタンクは、オレンのみを好み、それに合わせて調整されています。そのため、与えると急速に乳を出すのです。

key: Reborn's environment has been desecrated, so there's no longer many places to grow Berries.
en: Reborn's environment has been desecrated, so there's no longer many places to grow Berries.
ja: リボーンの環境は汚染されてしまい、木の実を育てられる場所はもう多くありません。

key: The forests around here are a bit of an exception.
en: The forests around here are a bit of an exception.
ja: この辺りの森は、少し例外的な存在です。

key: If you find a spot to grow Berries, feel free to use it.
en: If you find a spot to grow Berries, feel free to use it.
ja: 木の実を育てられる場所を見つけたら、自由に使ってください。

key: On another note, there are also a variety of sundries that have been lost in this area.
en: On another note, there are also a variety of sundries that have been lost in this area.
ja: それと別の話ですが、この地域には、様々な失くし物も落ちています。

key: We never mind passersby cleaning up, so if you find something, help yourself.
en: We never mind passersby cleaning up, so if you find something, help yourself.
ja: 通りすがりの方が片付けてくださっても構いませんので、何か見つけたら、ご自由にどうぞ。

key: To that tune, you might find this to be of some use.
en: To that tune, you might find this to be of some use.
ja: そういうことなら、これが役に立つかもしれません。

key: It'd be even more helpful if Trainers could just tell someone "itemfinder", so we wouldn't have to give this to them to get them to clean up...
en: It'd be even more helpful if Trainers could just tell someone "itemfinder", so we wouldn't have to give this to them to get them to clean up...
ja: トレーナーが誰かに「itemfinder」って言ってくれれば、片付けてもらうためにこれを渡す手間も省けるんですけどね……

key: ...Ah, pardon my wishful thinking.
en: ...Ah, pardon my wishful thinking.
ja: ……ああ、これは私の願望ですね、失礼しました。

key: Dad-gum it, I dropped my glasses while doing research in the woods...
en: Dad-gum it, I dropped my glasses while doing research in the woods...
ja: ちくしょう、森で調査してる時にメガネを落としちまって……

key: It's a miracle I made it out of that stupid forest-maze, but now what will I do?
en: It's a miracle I made it out of that stupid forest-maze, but now what will I do?
ja: あのバカな森の迷路から抜け出せたのは奇跡だけど、これからどうしよう?

key: \PN handed over the Tech Glasses.
en: \PN handed over the Tech Glasses.
ja: \PNはテックメガネを手渡した。

key: By golly, that's them! Miracles rain down on me!
en: By golly, that's them! Miracles rain down on me!
ja: いやはや、それだ! 奇跡が降ってきたぞ!

key: Oops, maybe I shouldn't make talk of miracles in a studious place like this...
en: Oops, maybe I shouldn't make talk of miracles in a studious place like this...
ja: おっと、こんな学術的な場所で奇跡なんて言葉を使うべきじゃなかったかな……

key: Anyway, why don't you take this?
en: Anyway, why don't you take this?
ja: とにかく、これを受け取ってくれないか?

key: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Heracross!
en: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Heracross!
ja: \PNはデパートシール「ヘラクロス」を手に入れた!

key: Hm? I see you don't have a Department Store Membership Card.
en: Hm? I see you don't have a Department Store Membership Card.
ja: ん? デパートのメンバーズカード、持ってないみたいだね。

key: Should you choose to get one, please come back to me for a Sticker.
en: Should you choose to get one, please come back to me for a Sticker.
ja: 手に入れたら、また戻ってきてシールをもらいに来て。

key: Why don't you take this?
en: Why don't you take this?
ja: これを受け取ってくれないか?

key: Now to get back to work... or find another excuse not to.
en: Now to get back to work... or find another excuse not to.
ja: さて、仕事に戻るか……それとも、また別の言い訳を見つけるか。

key: Did you know there's a certain Pokémon that evolves only when you want it NOT to evolve?
en: Did you know there's a certain Pokémon that evolves only when you want it NOT to evolve?
ja: 進化してほしくない時に限って進化する、そんなポケモンがいるって知ってた?

key: Ain't that crazy?
en: Ain't that crazy?
ja: イカれてると思わないか?

key: This is the kinda stuff I live for! Now we need to figure out why it does that here and not in other regions...
en: This is the kinda stuff I live for! Now we need to figure out why it does that here and not in other regions...
ja: これこそ、オレが生きがいにしてることなんだ! なんで他の地方じゃなくてここでそうなるのか、突き止めないとな……

key: Ah, hello again. Have you come to donate a Dunsparce to us?
en: Ah, hello again. Have you come to donate a Dunsparce to us?
ja: ああ、またお会いしましたね。ノコッチを寄付しに来てくれたんですか?

key: The Azurine Center has been beyond tardy in their shipments of Pokémon for reintroduction.
en: The Azurine Center has been beyond tardy in their shipments of Pokémon for reintroduction.
ja: アズリンセンターからの、再導入用ポケモンの発送が、ひどく遅れているんです。

key: We were scheduled to re-establish the Dunsparce population last month, but there's been no word from them.
en: We were scheduled to re-establish the Dunsparce population last month, but there's been no word from them.
ja: 先月、ノコッチの個体数を再確立する予定だったのですが、あちらから何の連絡もなくて。

key: It is a poor substitute, but, Trainer, should you encounter any Dunsparce, please consider donating them to us.
en: It is a poor substitute, but, Trainer, should you encounter any Dunsparce, please consider donating them to us.
ja: 代わりにはなりませんが、トレーナーさん、もしノコッチを見つけたら、こちらに寄付していただけないかと。

key: I will offer you a young Pokémon in return. We had planned to reintroduce them to the wild before, but were forced to cancel that operation.
en: I will offer you a young Pokémon in return. We had planned to reintroduce them to the wild before, but were forced to cancel that operation.
ja: お礼に、若いポケモンをお渡しします。以前、野生に再導入する予定だったのですが、その計画は中止せざるを得なくなったものです。

key: I understand.
en: I understand.
ja: わかりました。

key: I see. This will be a great boon, thank you.
en: I see. This will be a great boon, thank you.
ja: なるほど。これは大きな助けになります、ありがとうございます。

key: \PN traded Dunsparce for Tyrogue!
en: \PN traded Dunsparce for Tyrogue!
ja: \PNはノコッチとバルキーを交換した!

key: This will be an excellent addition to the populations' re-establishment. Thank you.
en: This will be an excellent addition to the populations' re-establishment. Thank you.
ja: 個体数の再確立に、大いに貢献してくれるはずです。ありがとうございます。

key: In fact, as a small extra thanks, why don't you take this as well?
en: In fact, as a small extra thanks, why don't you take this as well?
ja: それと、ちょっとしたお礼として、これも受け取ってもらえませんか?

key: Some of our old monitoring equipment was deprecated recently, and this was left over.
en: Some of our old monitoring equipment was deprecated recently, and this was left over.
ja: 古い観測機器の一部が最近廃棄されて、これが余ったんです。

key: I hear some Trainers make use of it?
en: I hear some Trainers make use of it?
ja: トレーナーの中には、これを活用する人もいるとか?

key: Please keep us in mind if you find any more Dunsparce!
en: Please keep us in mind if you find any more Dunsparce!
ja: ノコッチを他にも見つけたら、ぜひ私たちのことを思い出してくださいね!

key: Ah, are you trying to make your way through the local forests?
en: Ah, are you trying to make your way through the local forests?
ja: ああ、この辺りの森を進もうとしているんですか?

key: You'll find this to be helpful.
en: You'll find this to be helpful.
ja: これがきっと役に立ちますよ。

key: If you need more, you can buy them at a certain flower shop in Reborn City,
en: If you need more, you can buy them at a certain flower shop in Reborn City,
ja: もっと必要なら、リボーンシティのある花屋で買えます、

key: Or otherwise one of the oddballs who lives in the woods here can sometimes be convinced to part with some.
en: Or otherwise one of the oddballs who lives in the woods here can sometimes be convinced to part with some.
ja: それか、この森に住んでる変わり者の一人が、時々分けてくれることもありますよ。

key: If you need more honey, you can buy them a certain flower shop in Reborn City,
en: If you need more honey, you can buy them a certain flower shop in Reborn City,
ja: あまいミツがもっと必要なら、リボーンシティのある花屋で買えます、

key: Ugggh, I got a job here as an intern, but putting together data on the environment is way less interesting than I thought!
en: Ugggh, I got a job here as an intern, but putting together data on the environment is way less interesting than I thought!
ja: うわー、ここでインターンの仕事をもらったけど、環境データをまとめるのって、思ってたよりずっとつまんない!

key: I thought I'd be out touching the grass, but here I am, cranking away on application development...
en: I thought I'd be out touching the grass, but here I am, cranking away on application development...
ja: 外で草に触れながら働けると思ってたのに、気づいたらアプリ開発をひたすらこなしてる……

key: When they asked me for a password, I should've just told them "allfieldapp"...
en: When they asked me for a password, I should've just told them "allfieldapp"...
ja: パスワードを聞かれた時、「allfieldapp」とでも言っておけばよかった……

key: If I'd done that, I wouldn't have had to bother collecting information on things like Field Effects...
en: If I'd done that, I wouldn't have had to bother collecting information on things like Field Effects...
ja: そうすれば、フィールド効果みたいな情報をわざわざ集める手間もいらなかったのに……

key: I could just lay down in the grass and become one with the earth like I was meant to...
en: I could just lay down in the grass and become one with the earth like I was meant to...
ja: 本来そうあるべきだったみたいに、草の上に寝転んで、大地と一体になれたのに……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
